Release: llm 0.37.3

A bug fix release for LLM, mainly to cover a problem with the most recent Homebrew package of the software.

Homebrew now ships the latest SQLite, 3.54.1, which includes a fix that broke LLM's logging code.

Short version: in SQLite 3.54.0 the following SQL:

select json_object('a', (select json_array(1)))

Returns this:

{"a":[1]}

But in 3.54.1 the same query returns this:

{"a":"[1]"}

According to D. Richard Hipp:

That was a bug fix. Per the documentation, (SELECT json_array(...)) returns SQL text, not JSON. Hence the 3.54.1 behavior is correct and 3.54.0 was a bug.

The workaround looks like this:

select json_object('a', json((select json_array(1))))

kandidaty.zagolovok: Agents are sessions, not requests: size GKE node pools for AI agent sessions
kandidaty.tekst: AI agent sessions remain active and idle for most of the workday, making traditional one-Pod-per-session allocations inefficient for cluster resources. By using open-source tools like Agent Substrate and AX on GKE, developers can park idle sessions in object storage to release compute resources while maintaining session state. This approach optimizes resource utilization and reduces Kubernetes node costs by up to 40%.

Цитирует @ArtificialAnlys: Alibaba has launched Qwen4 Max, gaining 9 points over Qwen3.8 Max on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and landing 3 points behind Kimi K3.1 Pro at ~11% lower Cost per Task

Qwen4 Max, using xhigh reasoning effort, scores 43 on the Intelligence Index, 9 points ahead of Qwen3.8 Max (xhigh) and 3 points behind Kimi K3.1 Pro (max, 46)

Key takeaways:

➤ Qwen4 Max improves on every evaluation in the Index vs Qwen3.8 Max (xhigh, 34): HLE-Diamond +21 points (24% to 45%), AA-Omniscience +18 points, AutomationBench-AA +17 points, CritPt v2 +13 points, Terminal-Bench-Science +11 points, Terminal-Bench 4.0 +9 points, GDP.pdf +3 points, FrontierCode 2.0 +3 points and AA-Briefcase +82 Elo.

➤ Qwen4 Max costs $3.27 per Intelligence Index task, ~3x less than Qwen3.8 Max ($10.02) and ~11% less than Kimi K3.1 Pro ($3.68): This is driven by 25% lower per-token pricing than Qwen3.8 Max, 70% cheaper cache hits and lower token usage. Tencent Hy4 costs ~3x less per task ($1.03) than Qwen4 Max but scores 8 points lower on the Index.

➤ Qwen4 Max uses 39% fewer output tokens per task than Qwen3.8 Max: ~105k output tokens per Intelligence Index task vs ~171k for Qwen3.8 Max, ~72k for Kimi K3.1 Pro and ~78k for Tencent Hy4. Qwen4 Max uses fewer tokens, while increasing 9 points on the Intelligence Index

➤ Improvements in AA-Briefcase (knowledge work): On AA-Briefcase, our evaluation of agentic work across real business files, Qwen4 Max reaches 1686 Elo vs 1674 for Kimi K3.1 Pro and 1446 for Tencent Hy4.

➤ Qwen4 Max trails Kimi K3.1 Pro on Terminal-Bench 4.0 and Tencent Hy4 on FrontierCode 2.0: Qwen4 Max scores 48% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 vs 67% for Kimi K3.1 Pro and 37% for Tencent Hy4. On FrontierCode 2.0, @cognition’s private evaluation of real-world coding tasks, it scores 26%, level with Kimi K3.1 Pro (26%) and behind Tencent Hy4 (31%).

Key model details:

➤ Context window: 1M tokens

➤ Multimodal: Text and image input with text output

➤ Pricing: $1.50/$4.50 per 1M input/output tokens on Alibaba's first-party APIs, with a $0.075 cache hit price. This is lower than Qwen3.8 Max across the board ($2.00/$6.00, with a $0.25 cache hit price)

@Alibaba_Qwen: Qwen4-Max outperforms Qwen3.8-Max by +7.5% net on Agent Arena, making Alibaba #5 lab overall.

Цитирует @arena: Qwen4-Max by @Alibaba_Qwen is the #1 Chinese model on the leaderboard making Alibaba now the #1 Chinese lab and #5 lab overall, just behind Anthropic, Google, OpenAI and Meta.

It debuts overall at #14 on Agent Arena with +7.5% net improvement across 14.7k real-world agentic sessions from our global community, real traces on real tasks.

This is a major leap over Qwen3.8-Max
- Rank: #39 → #14 overall

The Chinese frontier on Agent Arena:
- #14 Qwen4-Max (Alibaba): +7.5%
- #19 Hy4 (Tencent): +5.7%
- #21 Kimi K3.1 Pro (Max) (Moonshot): +4.0%
- #26 MiMo-V2.6-Pro (Xiaomi): +1.5%
- #30 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (Max) (DeepSeek): +1.1%

Breaking down performance across signals:
Qwen4-Max improves over Qwen3.8-Max across all four reported signals, with particularly large gains in user satisfaction and steerability.
- #15 Praise vs. Complaint: +13% (best Chinese model)
- #13 Confirmed Success: +9% (best Chinese model)
- #19 Steerability: +8%
- #29 Bash Reliability: +3%

By category, it is a top-ranked Chinese model across all 3:
- #12 in Work: +9%
- #14 in Chat: +8%
- #16 in Code: +8%

Congrats to the @Alibaba_Qwen team on this release!

@testingcatalog: Nasiko has launched Open Runtime, an open-source tool that optimizes AI agent spending per task.

Before a long file reaches an AI model, Nasiko trims non-essential parts, reducing token consumption. In Nasiko's server-log-based test, costs per task fell 40% with no drop in performance.

Users can also give each agent a budget limit and have Nasiko stop the agent once it reaches its ceiling.

Цитирует @nasikolabs: Nasiko - Open Runtime platform for managing AI agents.
See every agent. Cut token spend by up to 50%. Route to the right model with the agent gateway. Govern tool access. Set permissions and budgets per agent, per team. One command. Same workflow.
Open Runtime for agents starts now. First, every token. Next, every action!
Start Free: https://buff.ly/k79CiWW 

#ai #tokenops #openruntime #agents

kandidaty.tekst:
@testingcatalog: OpenRouter ❤️ HuggingFace

HuggingFace switching its inference provider to OpenRouter!

> “Requests made to language models now go through OpenRouter, which picks the best provider for each call based on live price, speed and reliability, and retries on another provider if the first one fails.”

HuggingRouter 👀

Цитирует @OpenRouter: Open models on @huggingface now run through OpenRouter.

Each request goes to the provider with the best price, speed, and uptime for that model, with automatic failover. Everything runs on the same Hugging Face token and API.

You can also send your traces to Hugging Face Storage with Broadcast, so your requests live on the Hub next to your models, ready for things like evals or fine-tuning.

kandidaty.tekst:
@testingcatalog: August has launched “Instinct for Healthcare”, allowing August agent to call a doctor's office and book an appointment on behalf of a patient. 

August is an AI-powered health and wellness companion designed to help users interpret medical data, analyze symptoms, and navigate healthcare.

The agent can book appointments, handle insurance claims and prescription refills, giving users access to the full transcript of the calls it makes.

Цитирует @anuruddh_m: We raised $12M from @Accel and @PeakXV to put AI through the bullshit American healthcare puts you through.

Navigating healthcare is hard and all of us have a list of healthcare tasks we’ve been putting off. From visiting a doctor to filing an insurance claim, the tasks pile up and get put off.

We’ve already helped 10M people understand their health. August now talks to the health system on your behalf. Tell it what you need, and August takes care of it.

In the last few weeks, August spent 24,286 minutes on hold while finding the earliest available in-network doctor appointments for our early users.

It spent 366 minutes on hold for one person alone. It also helped another save $1,255 on an insurance claim. Naturally, the ones who tried it say that they can't ever imagine going back.

I’ve held the phone for hours calling doctors, while a disease made it hard to even hold the phone. I’ve felt lost and overwhelmed when dealing with a disease and the system. 

It’s why I started building August, so that all of us have a companion for our health.

Цитирует @Alibaba_Qwen: 📢 Meet Qwen4-Max, your new AI teammate for work, creativity, and discovery!

Qwen4-Max is built on a new MoE architecture with native vision and a 1M-token context window.

Highlights:
- Outperforms Qwen3.8-Max with up to ~50% fewer tokens, while average cost per task drops over 60% in our internal evaluation.
- Advances real-world productivity through greater proficiency with professional tools, stronger long-horizon execution, and higher-quality deliverables.
- Handles real tasks, including 3D modeling, game development, manufacturing, finance, law, healthcare, and frontier scientific discovery.
- $1.5/M tokens for input, $4.5/M tokens for output, and $0.075/M tokens for implicit caching — all lower than Qwen3.8-Max, with implicit caching down by 70%.

The API is live on QwenCloud. You can also try Qwen4-Max on Qwen Studio, QwenWork and Qoder. 

Start building today! 🚀
